sql: SELECT m.organization_id, m.notice_id, m.section_id, m.name, m.raw_identifier, m.scheme, m.country, n.published_at FROM organization_mentions m JOIN notices n ON n.id = m.notice_id WHERE m.organization_id IN (30916610,31542854,31553962,31614098,31624556,31549563,31622719,31562630,31537995,31594820,30975000,31575842) LIMIT 100
note: per-mention rows with notice dates for the 12 small members/movers of batch 3 (30976449 read grouped in c3-02)

sql: SELECT organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(notice_id) AS first_notice, MAX(notice_id) AS last_notice FROM organization_mentions WHERE organization_id IN (30976449) GROUP BY organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country LIMIT 100
note: grouped mention names of twin 30976449 (G10), to re-count the 89/15 split

sql: SELECT notice_id, section_id, field_id, ordinal, substr(value, 1, 200) AS value FROM notice_texts WHERE notice_id IN (30809630, 46703114, 46731924, 46742253, 46868863, 46868871, 47196489, 47196497, 46756426, 46767073, 46810401, 46788314, 47287106, 46826382, 46869185, 46922982, 47133574, 46947439, 46954293) AND section_id IN ('PROCEDURE', 'ORG-GB-CHC-1159706', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP17704R', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Charity Registration Number 1107830', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Charity Number 1159706', 'ORG-GB-UKPRN-10004116', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP16337R', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Registered charity no. 1034581', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP30178R', 'ORG-GB-CHC-Registered charity number 279057', 'ORG-GB-MPR-IP27793R', 'ORG-GB-UKPRN-GB-UKPRN10004116', 'ORG-GB-MPR-27793R') LIMIT 400
note: org-section fields and BT-21 title for the movers' and small twins' notices (role, address, name context)

sql: SELECT organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM organization_mentions WHERE organization_id IN (30929619) GROUP BY organization_id, name, raw_identifier, scheme, country LIMIT 100
